UsageNow

Plan AI capacity without giving us your credentials

UsageNow connects from your device to documented provider APIs you choose, explains remaining capacity and reset timing, and can privately sync secret-free snapshots through your Apple account.

How UsageNow handles your data

  • Direct official connections

    When you request a refresh, the app calls the selected provider's documented official API directly from your device using the connection you supplied. There is no UsageNow developer relay or UsageNow account.

  • Credentials stay on this device

    Provider credentials are held in the main app's Keychain with AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly protection. They are not synchronisable and are never sent to CloudKit, App Group, Widget, or Apple Watch.

  • Optional private Apple sync

    Only if you enable iCloud sync, minimized normalized usage snapshots, preferences, and the trial anchor can be stored in your private CloudKit database. Credentials and raw provider responses are excluded.

  • Three days, then one lifetime purchase

    The three-day full-access period begins only after the first successful live usage snapshot is saved. A non-consumable lifetime unlock follows; StoreKit loads the real local price and Apple handles purchase and Restore. There is no subscription or advertising.

Contact UsageNow support

Include your device model, Apple operating system and app version, provider compatibility name, connection method, status code, and approximate time. Never send an access token, password, cookie, organisation or workspace slug, full URL, request or response body, or headers.
